protocol.cost_model: spread + commission once per trade: forex and commodities $3/lot (measured on demo 2026-10-14, billed at the close), crypto 0.04%, stocks 0.004% of notional (help centre, unmeasured), indices 0

execution.exit: market order one whole bar + lag + queue after the bar it fired on; no broker-side stop on this account
execution.financing: multiday: 17:00 New York rollover schedule; current swap rates for every year

protocol.risk_unit: stop_day x average true daily range over 14 days -- timeframe invariant
protocol.sizing: 1.5% volatility-throttled stop risk, MT5 lots, 4x notional ceiling
